name: Antigravity CLI Delegation Skill
purpose: Delegates low-complexity, high-volume tasks (summaries, bulk extraction, boilerplate drafts, mechanical edits, log triage) to Gemini models through the Antigravity CLI agy, to reduce Claude token cost.
capabilities: Headless agy wrapper with JSON result parsing and denied-action reporting
Structured extraction with JSON schema output
Single-file write grants via exact-path permission rules
Delegation and verification policy for what agy may and may not handle

installation.instructions: Requires the agy CLI (Antigravity 1.4.x) at ~/.local/bin/agy, installed and signed in outside the repo. Run `agy models` to confirm it is available.

compatibility.notes: Network calls to Google's Antigravity service. Light on memory, but run calls one at a time while a render or Kokoro job is active.

licensing.notes: Workspace-owned skill and wrapper script. The agy CLI itself is a separately installed third-party tool under its own terms.

security.notes: Prompts and the files agy reads are sent to Google, so the skill forbids delegating secrets, .env content or credentials. Headless agy denies writes and commands by default; the wrapper grants only exact file paths and never uses --dangerously-skip-permissions.
